Class Scene

java.lang.Object
net.murat.lovert.Scene
public class Scene extends Object
Represents a 3D scene containing shapes and lights for ray tracing. Handles intersection tests and light management with zero-allocation performance.

This implementation is 100% garbage-free during render() execution. All temporary objects are pre-allocated as instance fields and reused.

    • intersectLocal

      public boolean intersectLocal(Ray ray, EMShape excludeShape, Intersection finalClosestTarget)
      High-performance, zero-allocation scene intersection test. Fully respects all EMShape visibility and rendering flags.

      Flag behavior:

      • isVisible() - If false and not shadow-only, shape is skipped
      • isShadowOnly() - Excluded from primary/reflection/refraction rays
      • isVisibleSpecial() - Handled downstream in traceRay
      • isShadowEnable() - Evaluated in findShadowCaster
      • isReflective() - Evaluated in shouldCalculateReflections
      • isRefractive() - Evaluated in shouldCalculateRefractions
      Parameters:
      ray - the ray to test against the scene
      excludeShape - the shape to ignore during intersection (typically the origin shape)
      finalClosestTarget - pre-allocated Intersection to hold the closest hit data
      Returns:
      true if a valid intersection was found, false otherwise

    • intersects

      public boolean intersects(Ray ray, double maxDistance)
      High-performance shadow ray collision checker. Tests if any shape blocks the path from ray origin to maxDistance.

      This method is 100% garbage-free and uses pre-allocated scratch objects.

      Parameters:
      ray - the shadow ray to test
      maxDistance - the maximum distance to check
      Returns:
      true if the ray hits any shape before maxDistance, false otherwise

    • getVisibleLightCount

      public int getVisibleLightCount(Point3 point)
      Checks if a point is visible from any light source (for soft shadows).

      Note: This method may allocate if the Light.isVisibleFrom() implementation allocates objects. The allocation is outside Scene's control.

      Parameters:
      point - the point to check
      Returns:
      the number of lights visible from the point
